posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
If you can't find a plugin to meet your needs that you are happy with, another option would be to use the ButtonPicture and TextPicture default plugins that come with MZ and make your own Show Choices options. Then you can put the images wherever you want.
But again, a plugin might be easier if you find one that you like. I can't offer any specific suggestions but you could search for something like "RPG Maker MZ show choices control plugin" to see what you get.
